title: Relative cohomological-dimension bound twice the fibre dimension for proper morphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must control arbitrary torsion sheaves by dimension induction, including singular and nonnormal schemes. Normalization produces a lower-dimensional cokernel, while the graph of a rational map to the projective line produces a derived error supported in codimension at least two; Leray then gives the sharp twice-dimension bound.
